subject: Full artifact purge request — prompts, generated outputs, and inference logs (SOW-882)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novacorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: support@novacorp.com
Date: 2027-06-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Data purge request: prompts & logs (SOW-882)

Hi Priyom,

Per our contract SOW-882 and following a regulatory review, NovaCorp requests a complete purge of all LLM interaction artifacts tied to customer_id: NC-77-490. Specifically we need: 

- All prompt inputs and model-generated outputs stored in any object store, DBs, or ephemeral caches (kv-cache) from 2026-01-01 through 2027-06-20;
- All inference request/response logs, traces, and request metadata (headers, request IDs);
- Any snapshots, backups, or retention copies associated with the above in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1;

We require a forensic-style confirmation with: a purge manifest listing deleted paths, a signed operations assertion (PDF) with timestamp and operator id, and the S3/DB deletion receipts. Please confirm scope, expected timeline, and whether any items are exempted (e.g., legal hold).

We prefer completion within 72 hours. If you need to escalate to Legal/Security, please do so and keep this thread.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Data Privacy Lead, NovaCorp
elena.ruiz@novacorp.com
+44 20 7123 4556

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data purge request: prompts & logs (SOW-882)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear scope. We can run the purge. Below is our standard operational workflow and the items we'll deliver as proof. Confirm the scope is limited to customer_id NC-77-490 and the two regions you listed (eu-west-1, eu-central-1). If you have additional systems (on-prem ingest, partner sinks), call that out.

High-level plan (estimated lead time: 48 hours once you confirm scope):
1) Intake & verification: open internal expunge job (expunge-job-423) and validate customer identifiers and legal holds (Security).
2) Discovery: enumerate S3 prefixes, DB collections, and runtime kv-cache keys that map to NC-77-490 using request IDs and customer tags.
3) Snapshot & manifest: take minimal operational snapshots for audit (kept only for the duration of the job), generate purge_manifest CSV with ARNs/paths and deletion actions.
4) Execute deletion: delete objects, database rows, and evict KV caches. For models running in hosted runtime we will flush per-request caches and rotate any short-lived keys.
5) Post-checks: verify deletion, run object listing scans, compile s3-deleted-paths.txt and kvcache-keys-removed.txt.
6) Evidence package: signed PDF assertion (operator + manager), CSV manifest, and a short ops runbook snippet.

Exemptions: backups under legal hold or eDiscovery flags are not deleted until Legal clears them; please flag if a hold exists.

Next steps for you: confirm "scope = NC-77-490, eu-west-1 & eu-central-1 only" and whether Legal needs to be CC'd.

I'll loop Ops and Security immediately after confirmation.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Customer Success (Account Lead) | Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com

Internal note: CC'd Marissa/Sean/Rishi for execution and audit.

Subject: ACTION: expunge-job-423 — NovaCorp NC-77-490 (scope confirmed)

Team — Priyom confirmed scope for NC-77-490 in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Legal hold: none indicated by customer. Please treat this as high priority.

Execution checklist (use expunge playbook v3.4):
- [ ] Run discovery script: /ops/scripts/discover-nc-artifacts --customer NC-77-490 --regions eu-west-1,eu-central-1 --output /tmp/expunge-423-discovery.json
- [ ] Generate purge_manifest_20270620.csv (path, type, size, action, operator)
- [ ] Delete objects with --force and record deletion-id tokens
- [ ] Evict kv-cache keys: run kv-expunge --job expunge-job-423 --confirm
- [ ] Scan backups and snapshots; if present, record and tag for Security review
- [ ] Produce s3-deleted-paths-20270620.txt and kvcache-keys-removed-20270620.txt
- [ ] Create ops_evidence_signature_20270620.pdf and upload to drive folder (see link)

Operator: Sean Gallagher — please pick this up and post status updates to this thread. Rishi, please prepare a short signed statement template for the PDF (legal-ready).

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: ACTION: expunge-job-423 — NovaCorp NC-77-490 (execution complete)

Marissa/Priyom — purge executed and verified. Summary below; evidence attached.

Execution summary (expunge-job-423):
- Discovery produced 1,842 object keys across two regions (eu-west-1: 1,142 keys; eu-central-1: 700 keys).
- Deleted all identified S3 objects and removed 2,310 DB rows from prompts/outputs collections (sharded).
- Evicted 1,256 kv-cache entries tied to request IDs.
- No snapshots tagged as legal-hold; existing automated backups outside retention window were already expired.

Artifacts produced and uploaded to drive:
- purge_manifest_20270620.csv (CSV, 24KB)
- s3-deleted-paths-20270620.txt (text, 34KB)
- kvcache-keys-removed-20270620.txt (text, 8KB)
- ops_evidence_signature_20270620.pdf (pdf, 12KB) — signed by Sean G. (operator) and Marissa C. (ops manager)

Verification steps performed:
- Re-listing of S3 prefixes returned zero user-facing objects; checksums confirm missing objects.
- DB query for NC-77-490 returns zero rows in prompts/outputs collections.
- KV-cache scans show zero entries matching the customer tag pattern.

Notes: we rotated short-lived cache tokens and invalidated transient request IDs in the runtime to prevent rehydratation. No partner sinks identified.

I'll attach the purge_manifest excerpt here as proof and upload full artifacts to the drive link Priyom provided.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
